rulesTestNames: keeps city plans read models server-only
read: server only; the website server reads one document per city with the Admin SDK
write: server only; rebuilt from organizer page read models (and published organizers in cities that have not launched) by functions/src/cityPlans, under the owner's Settings → Discovery rules
migrationNotes: The hourly rebuild creates every launched and planned city's document; no backfill script is needed.
A city that has not launched lists published organizers without page links, because their pages stay withheld until it launches.
The discovery object is required; the hourly rebuild adds it to every city, and a discoverySettings write rebuilds every city at once.
